tactical_replacement_rationale: Matheesha Pathirana is officially un-retained by CSK and enters the auction as RR primary death-overs target. If bidding escalates beyond budget, Mark Wood (73.89 ClutchIQ) or Naveen ul Haq provides elite change-of-pace variation.
With Tim David retained by RCB and Harry Brook banned by BCCI regulations, Glenn Maxwell and Mark Chapman represent the verified auction finishers available to eradicate death-over batting collapses.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman pairs with Ravi Bishnoi to deliver 8 overs of relentless spin control, bowling effectively inside the powerplay (ER < 6.80).
Jake McGurk and Travis Head were both un-retained by DC and SRH respectively. Acquiring either gives RR the most destructive powerplay batting pair in the league alongside Yashasvi Jaiswal.
With Sanju Samson now officially with CSK in retain.xlsx, RR requires dependable wicketkeeper-batter reinforcements to partner with Dhruv Jurel.
